dedupe_keys.name: a cloud native python gis framework for flood susceptibility screening and critical facility exposure analysis

description: This open Zenodo release contains a Python script and Jupyter notebook for a Miami flood-susceptibility and critical-facility exposure demonstration. The provider describes a cloud-run GIS multicriteria workflow that exports maps and publication-resolution figures. It can help a modeller assemble a transparent screening surface, intersect candidate flood exposure with hospitals or other facilities, and compare assumptions for Miami emergency planning. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this notebook and script. It is a methodological demonstration, not an adopted city hazard map or a validated hydraulic simulation. A limitation is that the public description does not identify input layers, factor weights, spatial resolution, facility inventory or measured validation outcomes; these require inspection before transferring results. The named manuscript is described as targeting a journal, not as published evidence. Zenodo lists both text files under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Neither source file was executed, and no exposure estimate was reproduced.
